blocks.text: The Philippine National Police (PNP) on Monday maintained that the first parliamentary elections in the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) remained “generally peaceful,” despite several shooting and explosion incidents reported in parts of the region.
